build.command: src=sources/deps/pcre1/pcre-8.45; cfg=sources/deps/gnu-config-helpers/autoconf-2.72/build-aux; cd "$src"; cp "$OLDPWD/$cfg/config.guess" config.guess; cp "$OLDPWD/$cfg/config.sub" config.sub; chmod +x config.guess config.sub; ./configure --prefix=/usr --enable-shared --disable-static; make -j2; make check; make install; ldconfig

tests.command:
set -eu
src=sources/deps/pcre1/pcre-8.45
cfg=sources/deps/gnu-config-helpers/autoconf-2.72/build-aux
cd "$src"
sha256sum config.guess config.sub > ../../pcre1-original-config.sha256
cp "$OLDPWD/$cfg/config.guess" config.guess
cp "$OLDPWD/$cfg/config.sub" config.sub
chmod +x config.guess config.sub
printf 'GNU Autoconf 2.72 helper hashes: '; sha256sum config.guess config.sub
printf 'Detected host: '; ./config.guess
printf 'Normalized host: '; ./config.sub loongarch64-linux-gnu
./configure --prefix=/usr --enable-shared --disable-static > ../../pcre1-configure.log 2>&1
make -j2 > ../../pcre1-make.log 2>&1
make check > ../../pcre1-check.log 2>&1
make install > ../../pcre1-install.log 2>&1
ldconfig
printf 'PCRE version: '; pcre-config --version
printf 'Installed headers: '; test -f /usr/include/pcre.h && echo yes
printf 'Installed libraries:\n'; ldconfig -p | grep -E 'libpcre\.so'
printf 'Test summary:\n'; tail -n 12 ../../pcre1-check.log
printf 'Original bundled scripts:\n'; cat ../../pcre1-original-config.sha256

dependencies.name: GNU Autoconf build helpers
dependencies.consumer: LoongArch host detection for PCRE configure

environment_assumptions: Do not enable PCRE1 JIT or OpenResty PCRE JIT
